classification_policy.ALREADY_COVERED: A concrete durable, compiler, runtime, or projection representation exists. PARTIAL does not claim full kernel-v0.2 conformance.
classification_policy.RUNTIME_GAP: The type must participate directly in deterministic state or frozen runtime relations, but has no first-class Dynamic representation.
classification_policy.SEMANTIC_ONLY: The type belongs in provenance, compiler, ledger, retrieval, or UI projections and must not become a Dynamic mutation merely to match the kernel vocabulary.
classification_policy.freeze_boundary: PAN-74 adds StatedPosition without renaming or changing the meaning of frozen POSITION/CaseReading fields. Remaining runtime gaps still require an explicit versioned migration or adapter decision.
